Details
This guidance provides information and outlines the core engineering and mathematics knowledge required for restricted, management level Certificates of Competency (STCW III/2 and III/3). The MCA General Engineering Science examinations are currently delegated to the International Association of Maritime Institutions (IAMI).
This is guidance to all Owners, Masters, Officers, Ratings and those concerned with maritime training. This guidance should be read with with MSN 1857 - Amendment 1 , MSN 1904 and replaces the syllabus published on UK seafarer careers: Training provision, information and examination syllabuses .

MIN 654 Engineering and Electro-Technical Officer Oral Exam Syllabus - Amendment 1
This Marine Information Note (MIN) provides information and outlines the updated Oral exam syllabus, for Merchant Navy engineer officers and Electro-Technical Officers, leading to the issue of a UK Certificate of Competency.
This is a notice to all Owners, Masters, Officers, Ratings and those concerned with maritime training.
All education and training programmes leading to a Certificate of Competency (CoC) must be mapped to the Code and approved by the MCA. The MCA Deck oral examination syllabus is mapped to the relevant STCW Code tables.
The oral examination forms part of the assessment for the attainment of all MCA Certificates of Competency, and all candidates must demonstrate an adequate knowledge of the English language.
